sips.name: fresh strawberry margaritas handcrafted by Laur herself. Let’s just say… it quickly turned into a little midday margarita madness and the giggles were flowing
sips.method: Muddle 3-4 fresh strawberries in a shaker. Add 2 oz tequila, 1 oz fresh lime juice, 1 oz orange liqueur, and a small splash of agave if you like it sweeter. Shake hard with ice and strain into a salt-rimmed glass over fresh ice.
